==Usage instructions==
This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Lucasfilm|Lucasfilm]]'s official website [https://lucasfilm.com Lucasfilm.com].

Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{Lucasfilm|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus <code><nowiki>http://www.lucasfilm.com/</nowiki></code>
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>nolive=1</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Lucasfilm|url=our-team/kathleen-kennedy|text=Kathleen Kennedy|archivedate=20161127074329}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Lucasfilm|url=our-team/kathleen-kennedy|text=Kathleen Kennedy|archivedate=20161127074329}}
